content:
**Blood Sacrifice!** is a Legendary Perk in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *One Wasteland For All* update.

When using V.A.T.S., the perk replaces the Action Point cost with a higher amount of Hit Points.

| Effects | | | 
| Rank | Description | Form ID | 
| 1 | Using AP in VATS now consumes HP instead at 150% more cost. | 005A59D1 | 
| 2 | Using AP in VATS now consumes HP instead at 125% more cost. | 005A59D2 | 
| 3 | Using AP in VATS now consumes HP instead at 100% more cost. | 005A59D3 | 
| 4 | Using AP in VATS now consumes HP instead at 50% more cost. | 005A59D4 | 

Prior to Patch 1.7.20.12, upon dying, the perk granted teammates +25/+30/+35/+40 Damage Resistance and healed them for 40/50/60/70 Hit Points over 8/10/12/14 seconds.
